title: The Day of the Son of Man – as in the days of Noah and Lot
description: When the Pharisees asked when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus answered that it does not come in a visible way, but is already among them. To his disciples he spoke about the Day of the Son of Man, which will come as suddenly as lightning. Just as it was in Noah's days when the flood came, and in Lot's days when fire and sulfur fell on Sodom, so it will be when the Son of Man is revealed. He urges them to remember Lot's wife, saying that one will be taken and the other left behind.
